verdict.rationale: Gusto documents recurring, payroll-cycle-bound automation: custom semi-monthly pay schedules, payroll automations that gather hours and flag anomalies, and an agent that prepares work before each payroll for owner approval. These are fixed to the payroll cadence, though, and there is no evidence of a general-purpose scheduler for user-defined jobs or workflows. missing for 10: user-configurable scheduling of arbitrary recurring jobs or workflows, scheduling via the MCP server or CLI, documentation of trigger and cadence controls, independent hands-on corroboration.
